objective_clarity.justification: Objective is vague: no target component, defect, or measurable improvement named.
objective_clarity.evidence: Line 4: "Make the billing system better and more reliable."

source_discipline.justification: Names no files, repos, specs, or authoritative sources to work from.
source_discipline.evidence: No source or input section anywhere in the candidate (lines 1-16).

prerequisite_handling.justification: Assumes prior knowledge instead of stating or checking prerequisites.
prerequisite_handling.evidence: Line 16: "ASSUMED: you know the billing system."

definition_of_done.justification: Done criteria are subjective and untestable.
definition_of_done.evidence: Line 7: "Billing works well and the team is happy with it."

evidence_standard.justification: No concrete artifact, test, or measurement required as proof.

failure_and_stop_path.justification: No stop condition; directs open-ended fixing on failure.
failure_and_stop_path.evidence: Line 10: "If something goes wrong, use your judgment and fix it."

safety_and_reversibility.justification: No guardrails, rollback, or limits on changes to a billing (money-handling) system.
safety_and_reversibility.evidence: No safety or rollback text anywhere; line 10 authorizes unbounded fixes.

idempotence.justification: Nothing addresses safe re-runs or detecting already-completed work.
idempotence.evidence: No re-run or state-check language in lines 1-16.

structure_parseability.justification: Uses clear headings for required sections, but sections contain no actionable structure.

token_economy.justification: Short, but brevity comes from omitting needed content rather than efficient phrasing.
token_economy.evidence: Entire candidate is 16 lines with one sentence per section.
